tif.tagspecs

Class AppleMakerNote

  • java.lang.Object
    • tif.CameraMarkerNote
      • tif.tagspecs.AppleMakerNote

  • public class AppleMakerNote
extends CameraMarkerNote
    Decodes proprietary Apple iOS and macOS MakerNote binary metadata structures embedded within EXIF containers, with the aim of closely matching the metadata extraction performed by Phil Harvey's ExifTool.

    Apple does not officially document the MakerNote binary specification. Consequently, the implementation is based on reverse-engineering the proprietary structures and adapting selected decoding algorithms from Phil Harvey's ExifTool Perl implementation.

    Implementation References

    The primary reference for Apple MakerNote tag definitions is the ExifTool Apple Tags documentation. Selected decoding algorithms have been adapted from Phil Harvey's Perl source code in ExifTool's Apple.pm and associated modules, and reimplemented in Java using the existing TIFF and binary-processing infrastructure of this project.

    ExifTool is also used as a reference implementation for validating extracted metadata values against actual image files.

    Decodes Apple iOS and macOS proprietary MakerNote binary metadata structures embedded within TIFF/DNG image containers, achieving exact functional parity with Phil Harvey's ExifTool. Apple does not officially document the MakerNote binary specification. H owever, the structures implemented herein are reverse-engineered and aligned with Phil Harvey's ExifTool Perl implementation.

    Implementation References

    The implementation is based on reverse-engineering Apple's undocumented MakerNote structures, using Phil Harvey's ExifTool as the primary reference. The Apple tag definitions are derived from the ExifTool Apple Tags documentation.

    Selected decoding algorithms have been adapted from Phil Harvey's Perl source code in ExifTool's Apple.pm and associated modules, and reimplemented in Java using the existing TIFF and binary-processing infrastructure of this project.

    ExifTool is also used as a reference implementation for validating extracted metadata values against actual image files.

    Apple MakerNote Binary Specification

    Apple MakerNote Binary Layout
    Offset / Range Size Description
    Bytes 0–9 10 bytes Preamble signature string "Apple iOS\0" (header) identifying the MakerNote payload.
    Bytes 10–11 2 bytes Version padding and alignment bytes.
    Bytes 12–13 2 bytes Endianness marker 'MM'. Always big-Endian order (Motorola byte ordering).
    Offset 0x0E (14) 2 bytes Entry Count read as unsigned short specifying the total number of MakerNote entries contained.
    Offset 0x10 onward Variable Flat 12-byte IFD entry blocks structured as:
    • Tag ID: 2-byte unsigned short identifier.
    • Field Type: 2-byte TIFF field type descriptor (TifFieldType).
    • Count: 4-byte unsigned integer element count.
    • Value/Offset: 4-byte field containing either inline data (if ≤ 4 bytes) or an absolute byte offset relative to the start of the MakerNote buffer (0x00).

    Binary Property List (bplist00) Architecture Reference

    Complex telemetry tags like RunTime (0x0003) and AEMatrix (0x0002) serialize data using Apple's binary property list format (bplist00).

    • Macro Structural Layout: 
           +-----------------------+
     | Header (8 bytes)      | -> "bplist00" magic signature
     +-----------------------+
     | Object Table          | -> Raw data markers, dictionaries, and numeric values
     +-----------------------+
     | Offset Table          | -> Fixed-size byte offsets pointing to objects in the table
     +-----------------------+
     | Trailer (32 bytes)    | -> Metadata block fixed at the very end of the array
     +-----------------------+
    • Detailed Trailer Structure (32 bytes from the end of the block):

      bplist00 Trailer Layout
      Offset from Trailer Start Size Field Name Description
      Bytes 0–5 6 bytes Null Padding / Marker Reserved / alignment bytes
      Byte 6 1 byte offsetIntSize Size in bytes of each entry in the offset table (1, 2, or 4)
      Byte 7 1 byte objectRefSize Size in bytes of object references inside dictionaries/arrays
      Bytes 8–15 8 bytes numObjects Total count of objects in the object table
      Bytes 16–23 8 bytes topLevelObject Index of the root dictionary/object
      Bytes 24–31 8 bytes offsetTableOffset Absolute byte offset where the offset table begins

    • Object Table Marker Ranges:

      bplist00 Marker Ranges
      Marker Range Data Type Description
      0x00 Null / Booleans 0x00 = Null, 0x08 = False, 0x09 = True
      0x10 – 0x13 Integers 1, 2, 4, or 8-byte integers (targeted by parser logic)
      0x20 – 0x23 Reals / Floats 4-byte or 8-byte floating-point numbers
      0x40 – 0x4F Data / Byte Buffers Raw binary data blobs (e.g., thumbnail bytes)
      0x50 – 0x5F ASCII Strings Standard text strings
      0x60 – 0x6F Unicode Strings UTF-16 text strings
      0xA0 – 0xAF Arrays Lists of object references
      0xD0 – 0xDF Dictionaries Key-value mapping structures

      • processBinaryPropertyList

        private void processBinaryPropertyList(byte[] block,
                                       MediaRecord record,
                                       java.util.List<MetadataInspectionEvent> events)
        Parses an Apple binary property list (bplist00) byte block, useful for decoding the RunTime MakerNote tag (0x0003), extracting the object offset table and scanning integer objects to identify RunTime components.

        The decoding approach is based on the binary property list processing implemented in Phil Harvey's ExifTool.

        Parameters:
        block - the raw binary property list byte array
        record - the target media record associated with the inspection batch
        events - the completed list of metadata inspection events to append to
